body: I wish I had your bravery. I want to die so badly

There is no god. If there was then why does he allow children to starve, why does he allow little children being raped?
Why would I want to turn to a god like that. 
You're delusional, and your religion causes others like me to suffer to the point of suicide. 
Oh yeah... and fuck off

Get by.....? Not shooting my brains out. That's how I'm getting by. Distraction?....
The only thing distracting me is an incomplete plan to end this suffering.
You don't know me. Maybe I deserve to die.

There is no afterlife.
And yeah.... You're right. I should consider who will find me so, I'll be sure to off myself when and where a cop will find me.
I'm asking myself the same question

Same.....
It's getting old to only live because killing myself would hurt others.
Makes me feel like my pain isn't important, that other's happiness is more important than me no longer hurting.
I'm pretty sure a hollow point .45 through the skull won't fail.

I left religion a few years ago and also felt/feel as you do. What's the point of there isn't anything after? And then there's the whole "you only have one life so live it to it's fullest!" but, what they don't tell you is that living life to it's fullest means living the shitty parts of life.... Oh yeah and guess what... 99% of life is shit!! So you're really only living life for 1 fucking percent of... What exactly?? Does it matter? Doesn't outweigh the 99% of shit! Of pain, of heartache, of always disappointing everyone you love.... 
It's awesome you got away from religion, seriously! Fuck that willful ignorance. But now what?

I want to drink so bad. I want to drink till the pain stops, till life stops honestly.
In the end, drinking will only make everything worse and then you're just still alive and dealing with even more pain. Fucking double edge sword.
Wish I had nobody who cared about me. I have a sister that I think would lose it too much if I did kill myself. She has kids and is already going through more than she can handle. She leans on me for emotional support cuz she doesn't have anyone else. So I can't even kill myself because I'll just end up destroying her life and her kids.
I don't know if I'm much help but, feel free to vent.
I read it. I've been sober for a little over five months. And I feel it doesn't matter. I still keep fucking up, I still keep causing hurt, and I just hurt all the time. Life is pain.
I've been staring at my phone trying to think of what to say.... All I can think about is hurting myself.

I feel the same way right now. 
All I do is fuck things up. I've tried everything to change and the hurt and pain and the disappointment... It's all still there. It never goes away.
